prototype.index_side: current active watchlist, not document storage

production.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS ingest_join_mv TO ingest_hits AS
SELECT _wc0_src.* EXCEPT (_wc0_value, _wc0_key), _wc0_rule.id AS indicator_id, 'raw' AS view
FROM (
  SELECT id, v AS _wc0_value, arrayJoin(if(length(_wc0_value) > 256, ['_wc_long_value'], arrayConcat(arrayDistinct(arrayMap(_wc0_i -> substring(_wc0_value, _wc0_i + 1, 3), range(toUInt64(greatest(toInt64(least(length(_wc0_value), 256)) - 2, 0))))), ['_wc_no_anchor']))) AS _wc0_key
  FROM ingest_src
) AS _wc0_src
ALL INNER JOIN (
  SELECT id, regex, _wc0_needles, arrayJoin([if(length(arrayElement(_wc0_needles, 1)) = 3 AND arrayAll(_wc0_i -> ascii(substring(arrayElement(_wc0_needles, 1), _wc0_i, 1)) BETWEEN 32 AND 126, [1, 2, 3]), arrayElement(_wc0_needles, 1), '_wc_no_anchor'), '_wc_long_value']) AS _wc0_key
  FROM (
    SELECT id, regex, if(needles_regex = regex AND needles_view = view, arraySlice(needles, 1, 3), CAST([], 'Array(String)')) AS _wc0_needles
    FROM watch FINAL WHERE active = 1 AND view = 'raw'
  )
) AS _wc0_rule ON _wc0_src._wc0_key = _wc0_rule._wc0_key
WHERE arrayAll(_wc0_n -> position(_wc0_src._wc0_value, _wc0_n) > 0, _wc0_rule._wc0_needles)
  AND match(_wc0_src._wc0_value, _wc0_rule.regex)
